package private

import (
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/transport/http/private/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

type Router struct {
	token   string
	handler *handlers.Handler
	enabled bool
}

func NewRouter(token string, summaries *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService) *Router {
	return &Router{
		token:   token,
		handler: handlers.New(summaries),
		enabled: token != "" && summaries != nil,
	}
}

// Register attaches private service endpoints under the internal contour.
func (r *Router) Register(g *echo.Group) {
	g.GET("/health", r.handler.Health)
	if !r.enabled {
		return
	}
	internal := g.Group("/v1", middleware.RequireInternalToken(r.token))
	internal.GET("/students/:student_id/learning-sessions/:session_id/summary", r.handler.GetLearningSessionSummary)
}
